title: A Cipher for the Drop
author: B. M. Yarrow
blurb: Theo Vane, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
